eligibility: Own collector off base and exactly one step from one own base. No worker currently on that base and no enemy worker on its four neighbours.
label: Command into the base on following transition, regardless of later collision or delivery.
bands: 0; (0,30); [30,100); [100,+inf). 30 is base recruitment cost, 100 is default cell cap. These are descriptive bins, not calibrated policy thresholds.
split: sha256 of ASCII match ID, first eight bytes unsigned big-endian modulo 5. Remainder 0 is held out. Both players in a direct match share the split. All newer games started after the frozen census maximum timestamp.
scope: Observed behavior. Per-game differences pair the heavy and light exposure buckets within each game; a return command is not a guaranteed deposit or a causal gain in utility.
